root_idea.summary: The supplied lexical evidence is centered on exertion under weight: rising with difficulty, being weighed down, and burdening another. It also records distinct extensions into distance, rivalry, astronomy, and gift-related expressions.
root_idea.development: The weight-and-strain branch includes both laborious rising and being overcome by weight, while separate derived and nominal branches develop into hostility, astronomical terminology, weather attribution, and soliciting gifts. No independent Maqāyīs or Mufradāt development is supplied.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form نَاءَ rather than the Quranic imperfect surface form تَنُوءُ.

senses.definition: To weigh heavily on or burden someone, oppressing them by its weight.
senses.usage_conditions: In the attested construction, the heavy thing is the subject and the person or group burdened is introduced with بِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise or arise with effort and difficulty, especially while bearing a burden.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With بِـ, the construction may describe a person rising with a burden; it is also used of a bodily part whose weight makes its movement laborious.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be overcome by weight and fall down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is reported as one of the verb’s opposite uses alongside rising under weight.
Figurative usage with بِـ, as in نَاءَ بِجَانِبِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a star or asterism, to rise or set aurorally at dawn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The recorded usage allows variation between the rising and setting of the star or asterism.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become distant, go far away; with بِـ, to render someone or something distant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This usage is reported as a transposed or dialectal form associated with نَأَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend with someone for glory, vie with him, and act hostilely toward him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III usage takes a person as its object and combines rivalry with hostile opposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prognosticate rain and related weather from the auroral rising or setting of a star or asterism, or to regard it as a نَوْء.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This belongs to the traditional astronomical-weather practice associated with the anwaʾ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or ask a person for a gift or present.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object of seeking is the person from whom the gift is requested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A star or asterism of the lunar mansions; also the auroral rising or setting associated with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote the star or asterism itself, its rising, or its setting; descriptions differ over which of the two events is primary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain or other weather phenomena traditionally thought to result from the rising or setting of a star or asterism.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an attributed or supposed influence of a نَوْء, not a claim about astronomical causation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Herbs or herbage regarded as resulting from a نَوْء.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative extension from vegetation associated with the rain attributed to a star or asterism.
This is a separately recorded figurative nominal use and is not merely the verbal meaning of seeking a gift.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most knowledgeable about the أَنْوَاء, the stars or asterisms and their associated phenomena.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective formed in an anomalous lexical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person from whom a gift or present is sought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of the person whose gift is requested.
